info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Currency Distribution Reviews API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews for branch currency distribution services, enhancing customer feedback and service improvement. It allows users to share their experiences regarding currency availability and distribution processes at specific banking branches. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions seeking to gather client feedback and improve operational efficiency. By leveraging this API, financial organizations can effectively monitor customer satisfaction and adapt their services accordingly.
